title: Decision
description: The result of Access.authorize. SERVER-INTERNAL: reason codes are recorded in audit rows and never returned to a browser, because a precise refusal reason is an information leak to an actor who is already unauthorised. The HTTP layer maps a denial to the frozen error envelope instead.

reason_code.description: ALLOWED exactly when allowed is true. SCHOOL_MISMATCH renders 404 rather than 403. TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED means never asserted; AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED means asserted too long ago.
